requirements_slice.system_goal: Bring the Today screen to a premium, short-first, explainable state without UI duplication or misleading technical copy.

in_scope.item: Today screen composition through canonical DayBrief hero + 4 domains + CTA only.
Top-layer verdict compression, moon-context deduplication, removal of raw technical tags, and suppression of misleading birth-time message.

out_of_scope.item: Backend truth-path repair for birth time provenance itself.

use_case.summary: User opens Today and sees one strong verdict, concise primary blocks, no duplicated moon/top-copy meaning, and no misleading technical notices.
use_case.scenario: Hero shows only verdict label plus `summary.headline` and `summary.subhead`; duplicate description/day-type prose is absent.
Moon context appears at most once as compact supporting context, not as a second headline.
Windows/risks do not expose raw tags like `high`, `morning`, or untranslated service values when they are not user-helpful.
UI does not show a user-facing warning about missing exact birth time while backend truth-path remains unresolved.

use_case.summary: User can read one bounded explanation path inside each of the four canonical Day domains.
use_case.scenario: Each score card can reveal why_text plus 2-4 supporting factors and practical guidance.
Each time window can reveal why the window is strong/soft/caution and what actions fit it.
Each risk can reveal mechanism, typical manifestation, supporting factors, and short mitigation guidance.

business_invariants.invariant: First layer MUST stay shorter than the current duplicated presentation.
Explainability MUST support the visible blocks instead of living only as a detached technical footer.
User-facing copy MUST avoid false or technically ambiguous claims about birth time availability.
Short advice MUST remain human, premium, and mechanism-aware rather than generic imperative boilerplate.

expected_failure_handling.item: If richer details are absent, UI MUST degrade gracefully without exposing raw JSON, booleans, or service tags.
If backend detail fields are not yet shipped, frontend MUST preserve concise first-layer rendering and omit unavailable second-layer sections.

known_defects.defect: Top hero repeats the same meaning across day-type/description/headline/subhead.
Moon context currently competes with the main verdict as a second semantic center.
Windows/risk-related UI may surface raw service labels instead of polished localized copy.
UI may claim lack of exact birth time even when the stored profile is accurate.
Score/window/risk cards do not yet expose supporting factors and reasoning depth.

success_criteria.criterion: Today top screen reads as one confident verdict with no duplicate semantic layer.
Moon appears only as compact context.
No raw technical tags or misleading birth-time notice remain visible in Today UI.
Execution packet defines canonical Day DTO and honest state behavior without windows/risks reconstruction.
Worker can execute against an explicit bounded write scope and verification plan.
